modified_caption: Average accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis). The bar chart depicts the performance of five distinct methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClInGS (w/), and ClInGS. The vertical axis, labeled 'Average Performance,' spans from 0 to 60 in 10-unit increments. The Standard method (orange) achieves approximately 52, while Self-RAG (beige) stabilizes at a slightly lower value of 48. FactTune (light green) consistently exceeds Self-RAG with a performance of roughly 55. ClInGS (w/) (light blue) marginally surpasses FactTune at about 53, whereas ClInGS (blue) demonstrates a marked improvement, reaching nearly 58. Notably, Self-RAG and FactTune exhibit minimal performance divergence, suggesting comparable efficacy between these two approaches.
